title: Optimize reactants and compute harmonic frequencies
action: Build SiH2 and P4 structures; perform geometry optimization at BP86/TZVP; carry out harmonic vibrational frequency analysis to obtain zero-point energy corrections.
description: Geometry optimization and frequency calculation for isolated reactants.

title: Locate and optimize transition state A (bimolecular)
action: Locate the transition state for SiH2 + P4 direct insertion (TS A, model 1) at BP86/TZVP and optimize its geometry.
description: Transition state geometry optimization for the bimolecular pathway.

title: Locate and optimize transition state B (termolecular)
action: Locate the transition state for SiH2 + 2 P4 reaction (TS B, model 2) at BP86/TZVP, where a second P4 binds axially at silicon; optimize its geometry.
description: Transition state geometry optimization for the termolecular pathway including a second P4.

title: Optimize product geometry
action: Optimize the geometry of the insertion product (bicyclobutane structure 3) at BP86/TZVP.
description: Geometry optimization of the product of the first insertion step.

title: Frequency calculations on stationary points
action: Perform harmonic vibrational frequency calculations at BP86/TZVP on optimized TS A, TS B, and product geometries. Confirm TS A and TS B each have exactly one imaginary frequency. Extract ZPE corrections.
description: Vibrational analysis to characterize stationary points and obtain ZPE.

title: Compile and report key results
action: From optimized geometries and energies/ZPE, extract bond lengths and compute activation energies for both models. Write results.json.
description: JSON file containing geometric parameters and activation energies for the first insertion step of SiH2 into P4 at BP86/TZVP.
output_schema: A JSON object with keys: "TS_A_bond_lengths" (object with keys "P1P2", "P1Si3", "P2Si3" in Å), "TS_B_bond_lengths" (object with keys "P1P2", "P1Si3", "P2Si3", "P4Si3"), "product_3_bond_lengths" (object with keys "P1Si3", "P2Si3", "P1P2"), "DeltaEa_model1" (kcal/mol), "DeltaEa_ZPE_model1" (kcal/mol), "DeltaEa_model2" (kcal/mol), "DeltaEa_ZPE_model2" (kcal/mol). All numeric values are floats.
